input.body:
label: bug
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The Export button remains disabled after a failed export because the `busy` state is only reset in the `.then()` callback of `exportReport`, which fails silently if the fetch rejects. The error is not caught, so `setBusy(false)` never runs. This matches the maintainer's note: the Export button feature is responsible, and the file to fix is `src/components/ExportButton.tsx`.

input.title: Re-enable Export button after failed export to allow retry
input.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The `ExportButton` component disables itself during an export (`setBusy(true)`) but does not reset the `busy` state if the export fails. This leaves the button greyed out until the page is reloaded. The fix is to call `setBusy(false)` in the `.catch()` handler of `exportReport` to re-enable the button after a failure, allowing the user to retry the export.

input.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The `ExportButton` component disables itself during an export (`setBusy(true)`) but does not reset the `busy` state if the export fails. This leaves the button greyed out until the page is reloaded. The fix is to call `setBusy(false)` in the `.catch()` handler of `exportReport` to re-enable the button after a failure, allowing the user to retry the export.
